title: Jiangshi
dek: Returned from prolonged death, Jiangshi trusts the continuity of ancestors, family and chosen love. Her shadows can shelter and heal; her care remains present even when gods, factions and a resurrected friend fail.

facts.Core promise: We are here for you. To comfort.
facts.History: June 2024 loss · roughly 7½ months of absence remembered; exact sequence unresolved
facts.Central distinction: Sustaining is not the same as choosing to love
facts.Partnership: Adelia · later described as married; ceremony and date unknown
facts.Spiritual trust: Family and ancestors · shadows as shelter and transition
facts.Hope: Hope, love and faith in her companions · 27 February 2026
facts.Unresolved: Death/return dates and mechanism; ancestry; Smokey’s full history

body:
Before her own death, Jiangshi already practiced a distinctive care: she could wrap a wing around someone, listen if they wanted to speak, and refuse to pry. Death intensified that instinct rather than creating it.

The loss that keeps acting

Jiangshi’s loss belongs to the June 2024 Gael and Void history. It becomes central to Nienna’s crisis over retreat and cowardice. Even while absent, what happened to her continues to alter Nienna, Gartina, Adelia, and the moral meaning of survival. Her history demonstrates that absence does not end causality.

Shadows

Jiangshi’s imagery refuses the simple equation of shadow with evil. A shadow can conceal, frighten, shelter, or comfort. Her later language around the Shadowlands and Death’s door gives that symbolism personal weight.

The Zarathis garden conversation

In the garden, Jiangshi speaks through bonsai, Wabi-Sabi, ancestry, patience, harmony, tea, and shadows as rest. Her sharpest question tests love of nature at the point of sacrifice: is there a person for whom one would choose family over nature?

The question separates being sustained, comforted, or protected by a system from being consciously loved by another person. Nature may keep someone alive; a shadow may shelter them; neither necessarily chooses them.

Presence instead of victory

When Gartina becomes vulnerable about her dead parents, Jiangshi does not answer with another theory. She places a hand on Gartina’s shoulder. The gesture does not defeat Gartina’s argument; it demonstrates the relational care Jiangshi believes analysis alone cannot replace.

The unsaid word

After approximately seven and a half months, Jiangshi returns. The exact day of her June 2024 loss and the exact day of her return remain unresolved. She struggles to say that she was dead. The gap matters. Her fear of losing Adelia is not abstract dependency; it is shaped by months in which the world continued without her and people gathered for her memorial.

4 March 2024 · blessed by shadows

Jiangshi’s association with shadows predates her death. When Adelia refers to a gift from them, Jiangshi replies that she too has been “blessed” by the shadows. Darkness is not a single allegiance or a single moral condition in her life: it can carry ancestors, healing, rest, music and memory.

Her experience of shadow should not be conflated with the Void or treated as proof of devotion to Death. The protective and ancestral meanings she gives it are part of her own testimony.

A memorial and a difficult chronology

Bitoshi remembers coming to Pristinia in search of Jiangshi and finding her memorial at the Common Man instead. Her absence changes the lives of the people who expected to find her there. Her later return does not make their grief, or the memorial, untrue.

The June loss and roughly seven-and-a-half-month absence are remembered alongside earlier Gael episodes: the coffin landing on 14 July 2024 and Moirah returning with Jiangshi’s body on 5 August. Those scenes do not yet settle the sequence of her death, recovery and enduring return. A body being carried back is not enough to date a resurrection. The exact return day and the roles of Moirah and Namo’o remain unresolved.

Ancestors in the darkness

On 30 July 2025, Jiangshi describes the Shadowlands as cold, dark and desolate, yet recalls ancestors and visitors reaching her there. This is lived testimony rather than a complete map of the afterlife.

She calls divine grace fickle while saying family and ancestors have not failed her. Their magic has sustained her and grown. Her skepticism concerns reliability: she does not claim that gods are unreal or that ancestors must always be correct. Where higher powers cannot be relied upon, she turns toward supporting loved ones and friends.

25 April 2025 · Adelia comes home

After a horrific fight, Adelia tells Jiangshi that she prayed daily for her to hear. Jiangshi offers calming herbs, healing shadow-smoke, Smokey and physical closeness. She says, “We are here for you. To comfort.”

She does not insist that Adelia explain what happened. Intense affection does not become a demand for access to another person’s inner life. Her language of a “shadow jewel” can coexist with giving Adelia space.

Jiangshi also asks what might have been learned from a destroyed cultist temple. When shadows enter the conversation, she asks about their function rather than assuming they mean evil. Adelia identifies the cult as Tiamat’s.

23 July 2025 · chosen gentleness, lethal skill

Jiangshi kills a dragon with a small frozen strike to its back. It crashes amid buildings, fire and rubble. Adelia watches and thinks, “That’s my future wife.” Jiangshi’s comfort is not helplessness; it is one use of a person capable of decisive violence.

Their romantic commitment and future-wife language are explicit. Later accounts treat Adelia and Jiangshi as married, but the ceremony and date are unknown. Their partnership must not be given an invented wedding chronology.

2 December 2025 · trust beyond factions

Jiangshi explains that they have stayed away from politics and factions while assessing them, finding these institutions fickle. Her political caution resembles her religious caution: trust rests first in people and ancestors whose presence has endured.

This does not establish total withdrawal from civic life. Nor does distrust settle whether a particular institution deserves it. Her preference for a close circle leaves a live question about when care must also become public action.

January 2026 · home after mourning

Jiangshi enters the Common Man alive, recognising its sounds and scents and meeting people who arrived while she was absent. Bitoshi can now sit with the person whose memorial he once encountered. The tavern holds both histories: a community learned to mourn her there, and she came home.

27 February 2026 · Hope, love and faith

At Hope, Jiangshi stands with Adelia and Bitoshi beside the living tree amid desolation. She speaks of Hope prevailing alongside love and her faith in the two people whose hands she holds. A blood tear falls. Her faith is placed in companions, rather than in a guarantee that every power will protect them.

She sees Magnus’s resurrection as a chance for redemption. His subsequent acceptance of Death’s gift and attack on Hope do not make that chance a promise of change. He chooses betrayal.

Afterward Jiangshi assists Hope, stays with Adelia and comforts her. Magnus’s declaration that only ambition remains is his claim, not a conclusion the scene forces Jiangshi to accept. Her answer is enacted in the care she continues to offer.

Connection that survives interruption

Nienna’s crisis over retreat, Adelia’s grief, Bitoshi’s memorial experience and Wren’s memory of recovering Jiangshi’s body belong to the history of her absence. The accusations others make over the loss are not automatically Jiangshi’s own judgment.

Her return continues those relationships instead of resetting them. The garden conversation with Gartina still matters, as do the people who learned to live without her. Darkness can be cold and desolate without being empty; that distinction gives her continued presence its weight.

Gael: love, community and the meaning of Hope

After Nienna’s Hallowing sacrifice, Jiangshi tells Adelia that Hope can point toward a life of light and love. She argues that friendship, family and shared suffering can bind people against Death, extending resistance beyond martial power. Her account is a philosophy formed through love and loss, not a settled law that affection guarantees survival.

In December 2024, she calls Adelia the true Hope of Gael in her eyes. Adelia replies that hope belongs to every member of the community. Their exchange links Adelia’s protective life to the Tree without making her the sole bearer of its meaning.

In July 2026, Jiangshi resets the small sanctuary she and Adelia had made for recall, while Bitoshi helps with the sanctuary area. Her suggestions for prayer and meditation spaces give connection a practical future; a completed temple is not established.

brief.basis: Existing public dossier, explicit status facts and named timeline participants. Selected events are a reading guide, not a complete list or a ranking of importance.

relationshipMap.title: Jiangshi’s relationship web
relationshipMap.intro: Jiangshi understands care as consciously chosen presence: comfort offered without prying and love distinguished from mere protection. Select a tie to see how death, return, and memory deepen that philosophy.

nodes.title: Adelia
nodes.subtitle: The person she fears losing
nodes.history: Jiangshi is lost in Gael and remains dead or absent for roughly seven and a half months. After returning, her fear of losing Adelia is shaped by knowing that the world and its relationships can continue without her.
nodes.consequence: Adelia’s later binding to Hope cannot be only a cosmic transformation. For Jiangshi, it is also the possible loss or alteration of a person she consciously chooses.
nodes.evidence: Loss, return, and fear are established; their full private chronology remains incomplete.

nodes.title: Nienna
nodes.subtitle: Survival burdened by Jiangshi’s loss
nodes.relation: Absence that changes another person’s moral memory
nodes.history: Jiangshi’s loss becomes central to Nienna’s crisis over retreat and cowardice. Nienna carries the question of whether survival abandoned someone who could not be saved.
nodes.consequence: Jiangshi’s later return does not retroactively make Nienna’s fear and guilt unreal. Absence has already acted upon the living.
nodes.evidence: The loss and its effect on Nienna are established; every step of the original Gael event remains incomplete.

nodes.title: Gartina
nodes.subtitle: A hand instead of a rebuttal
nodes.history: In the Zarathis garden, Jiangshi and Gartina debate nature, knowledge, family, and chosen love. When Gartina becomes vulnerable about her dead parents, Jiangshi places a hand on her shoulder.
nodes.consequence: The gesture enacts Jiangshi’s argument: consciously chosen presence can do something explanation and sustaining systems cannot do alone.
nodes.evidence: The garden exchange and gesture are directly preserved; their wider friendship remains partial.

nodes.title: Wren
nodes.subtitle: Mourned through the love of others
nodes.history: Wren grieves Jiangshi despite not knowing her closely because she remembers recovering Jiangshi’s body and understands what Jiangshi means to Adelia, Gartina, and the company.
nodes.consequence: Jiangshi’s social presence extends beyond direct friendship. Another person can carry her importance by witnessing the love around her.
nodes.evidence: Wren’s grief is established; a close independent friendship is not.

nodes.title: Ancestors & Shadowlands
nodes.subtitle: Connection within the darkness
nodes.relation: Personal testimony of ancestors and visitors
nodes.history: Jiangshi remembers cold, desolate Shadowlands in which ancestors and visitors reached her. Her shadows can preserve care and connection.
nodes.consequence: The experience supports her trust in continuity without making death harmless or equating ancestral shadow with Dumuzi.
nodes.evidence: Her testimony is preserved; a complete afterlife geography and resurrection mechanism remain unresolved.

nodes.title: Magnus Niriin
nodes.subtitle: Redemption offered, betrayal witnessed
nodes.relation: Another chance followed by immediate rupture
nodes.history: At Hope, Jiangshi frames Magnus’s resurrection as another chance for redemption. After he accepts Dumuzi’s gift and wounds Hope, she acts with Adelia to save what remains.
nodes.consequence: The scene tests Jiangshi’s care at its limit. Offering the possibility of change does not require denying betrayal once a person chooses it.
nodes.evidence: Her words and immediate response are directly observed; her later judgment remains incompletely recovered.

insights.label: Central bond
insights.note: Love is consciously chosen presence after the world has already separated them once.

insights.label: Philosophy enacted
insights.note: Comfort can be offered without winning an argument.

insights.label: Historical force
insights.note: Death changes Nienna, Wren, Adelia, and the company before Jiangshi returns.

insights.label: Living distinction
insights.note: Protection and nature are not identical to a person deliberately loving another.

profile.personality: Jiangshi is defined less by death than by continuity through death. The archive treats her as a person whose relationships survive bodily absence, recovery, and transformation, forcing everyone around her to distinguish mourning from deciding that someone is finished.
profile.achievements: She belongs to the first Calling, helps open Prima’s earliest roads, is lost during the Gael and Void history, and later returns after approximately seven and a half months of death. Her coffin reaches Gael, Moirah brings her body back at visible cost, and her return gives earlier memorials a new meaning without erasing them.
profile.relationships: Adelia’s refusal to stop recognizing her is central, while Nienna’s retreat and the blame from Bitoshi and Adelia expose the cost of choosing who can still be saved. When Jiangshi returns to the Common Man, the room holds both Bitoshi’s memory of her memorial and her own recognition of ordinary scents and sounds.
